title: The Story of a Big Oar
overview: In the spring of 1948, when the People's Liberation Army rebelled against power, the enemy entrenched on Horseshoe Island tried to fight to death. The members of our rangers managed to obtain a map of the enemy's military facilities on the island, and gave it to the grandfather of the old trafficman Xiao Tie, who asked him to send it to the PLA. Xiao Tie offered to go to sea with Grandpa to complete this task.
